ask.seekingTitle: Seeking $400,000 pre-seed investment to launch the first pilot production cycle.

scenarioB.title: Scenario B — Strategic Launch Partner
scenarioB.details: $400K cash + facility access → up to 25% equity
scenarioB.note: Additional facility-related equity is milestone-based and depends on legal access, site readiness, utility capacity, logistics, storage, and duration of use.

scenarioC.title: Scenario C — Facility Partner
scenarioC.details: Factory / land / workshop access → 3–5% equity or revenue-share
scenarioC.note: Alternative: revenue-share or discounted lease instead of equity.

ask.fund5: 5% ($20,000) — Digital platform, marketing and demo projects
ask.facilityDesc: We are not building a factory from scratch in phase one. We will launch a lean pilot production workshop inside a leased or strategic partner industrial facility. This reduces CAPEX, accelerates launch, and allows us to validate production, certification, first sales, and B2B/B2G demand before scaling.
ask.partnerDesc: The ideal investor can contribute not only capital, but also: industrial space, land or factory access, utilities and storage, B2B/B2G connections, pilot locations, ESG or corporate sponsorship channels.
ask.cta1: Join the first Waste-to-Life infrastructure platform from Uzbekistan.
